{{Otheruses|Harvest}}
The '''Harvest Moon Feast''' was an event on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Held at night, the feast featured the Ewoks' beloved [[Rainbow Berry Pie|rainbow berry pie]].
